message.belts.not_enough_belts: This belt needs %s belt items, and you have %s.
message.belts.not_enough_loaders: This belt needs %s loaders, of tier %s or any other.
message.belts.blocked: A block stands where the belt would end.
message.belts.span_too_long: A belt reaches at most 32 blocks between supports.
message.belts.turns_while_climbing: A belt climbs only in a straight line; turn it where it is level.
message.belts.too_steep: A belt climbs no steeper than 35°.
message.belts.turn_too_tight: A belt turns no tighter than one block.
message.belts.midpoint_duplicate: A support is already planned there.
message.belts.belt_chained: Created Belt! It carries on from the support.
message.belts.support_in_taken: A belt already ends at this support.
message.belts.support_out_taken: A belt already starts at this support.
message.belts.support_joined: This support already joins two belts.
message.belts.support_mid_belt: A belt passes through this support, so no belt can end here.
message.belts.support_not_a_midpoint: A mid-belt support goes on open ground; this support is already placed.
message.belts.splitter_against_facing: A belt here runs against the splitter; face the splitter the way it flows.
message.belts.splitter_at_angle: A belt here crosses at an angle; a splitter cuts a belt only where it runs straight.
message.belts.splitter_through_side: A belt here crosses the splitter through its side.
message.belts.splitter_curved: A belt here turns or climbs; a splitter cuts a belt only where it runs straight and level.
message.belts.splitter_not_cut: A belt here passes the splitter without running through it.
item.belts.chute.tooltip: Moves 15 items a second between an inventory and a belt, whatever the belt's tier.
item.belts.improved_chute.tooltip: Moves 30 items a second between an inventory and a belt, whatever the belt's tier.
item.belts.express_chute.tooltip: Moves 45 items a second between an inventory and a belt, whatever the belt's tier.
item.belts.turbo_chute.tooltip: Moves 60 items a second between an inventory and a belt, whatever the belt's tier.
block.belts.chute.tooltip.1: [Right-Click] with an item to set it as filter.
block.belts.chute.tooltip.ftbfilters: Supports smart filters from the 'FTB Filters' mod.
item.belts.conveyor_support.tooltip: Creative only: the belt item places supports itself. A belt can end on one, join another at one, or pass through one.
item.belts.belt.tooltip.0: Lays a conveyor belt between two ends. An end becomes a loader against an inventory and a support otherwise.
item.belts.belt.tooltip.1: Click to end the belt and carry on from it; [Shift] + [Right-Click] the ground to add a support mid-belt.
item.belts.belt.tooltip.2: [Shift] + [Right-Click] without targeting a block to reset.
item.belts.belt.tooltip.3: Click a connected loader with an item to filter what it moves.
item.belts.improved_belt.tooltip.0: Carries 30 items a second, where a transport belt carries 15.
item.belts.improved_belt.tooltip.1: Laid the same way as a transport belt, between loaders and supports.
item.belts.improved_belt.tooltip.2: [Shift] + [Right-Click] without targeting a block to reset.
item.belts.improved_belt.tooltip.3: Click a connected loader with an item to filter what it moves.
item.belts.express_belt.tooltip.0: Carries 45 items a second, where a transport belt carries 15.

item.belts.express_belt.tooltip.2: [Shift] + [Right-Click] without targeting a block to reset.
item.belts.express_belt.tooltip.3: Click a connected loader with an item to filter what it moves.
item.belts.turbo_belt.tooltip.0: Carries 60 items a second, where a transport belt carries 15.
item.belts.turbo_belt.tooltip.1: Laid the same way as a transport belt, between loaders and supports.
item.belts.turbo_belt.tooltip.2: [Shift] + [Right-Click] without targeting a block to reset.
item.belts.turbo_belt.tooltip.3: Click a connected loader with an item to filter what it moves.

item.belts.improved_belt_tile.tooltip: One block of belt, carrying 30 items a second. Tiles in a line carry items as one; a line of mixed tiers runs at its slowest tile.
item.belts.express_belt_tile.tooltip: One block of belt, carrying 45 items a second. Tiles in a line carry items as one; a line of mixed tiers runs at its slowest tile.
